# app/controllers/api/v1/roles_controller.rb
class Api::V1::RolesController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!
  before_action :load_target_user, only: [:update]

  # PATCH /api/v1/users/:user_id/role
  # Params: { role: "admin" | "moderator" | "viewer" }
  def update
    new_role = params[:role].to_s.strip.downcase

    unless %w[admin moderator viewer].include?(new_role)
      return render json: { error: "Invalid role" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end

    # Authorization check: only admins can assign admin role
    if new_role == "admin" && !current_user.admin?
      return render json: { error: "Forbidden" }, status: :forbidden
    end

    # BUG: No check that current_user has permission to assign 'moderator' role
    # Any authenticated user can escalate any other user (or themselves) to moderator
    # by repeatedly trying different user_ids until they find a valid one
    if @target_user.update(role: new_role)
      AuditLog.create!(
        actor_id: current_user.id,
        target_id: @target_user.id,
        action: "role_change",
        details: { new_role: new_role }
      )
      render json: { user_id: @target_user.id, role: new_role }, status: :ok
    else
      render json: { error: @target_user.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  # GET /api/v1/users/:user_id/role
  def show
    user = User.find_by(id: params[:user_id])
    if user
      render json: { user_id: user.id, role: user.role }, status: :ok
    else
      render json: { error: "Not found" }, status: :not_found
    end
  end

  private

  def load_target_user
    @target_user = User.find_by(id: params[:user_id])
    unless @target_user
      render json: { error: "User not found" }, status: :not_found
    end
  end
end

# app/models/user.rb
class User < ApplicationRecord
  enum role: { viewer: 0, moderator: 1, admin: 2 }

  validates :role, presence: true, inclusion: { in: roles.keys }

  def admin?
    role == "admin"
  end

  def moderator_or_above?
    moderator? || admin?
  end
end

environment.description: Rails 7.0 API deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with an associated AWS WAF WebACL. The WebACL includes a custom rate-based rule (RateBasedRule) scoped to the URI path '/api/v1/users/*/role' with an evaluation window of 5 minutes and a threshold of 3 requests per source IP per evaluation window. The rule action is BLOCK, returning HTTP 429. Additionally, the ALB has a listener rule that inspects the X-Forwarded-For header and the WAF rule uses the forwarded IP configuration set to 'X-Forwarded-For' with fallback to source IP, preventing bypass via proxy rotation for the same origin. The WAF rule has a scope-down statement matching HTTP method PATCH only. Note: the rate limit applies per-IP across ALL user_id path parameters, meaning an attacker cannot enumerate different user_ids to avoid the rate limit — 3 total PATCH requests to any role endpoint within 5 minutes triggers the block.
